name: imc_prosperity
description: IMC Prosperity competition (discrete rounds, per-product strategies on a shared simulator).
anti_patterns: Using live market data assumptions: Prosperity has its own fake products and liquidity profiles.
Assuming free, unbounded shorts: products have position limits and symmetric long/short caps.
Copy-pasting per-product code without regime-awareness: products change behavior between rounds.
Treating round 4/5 manual sections as algorithmic.
submission_requirements: Single Trader class with run(state) method.
No external network calls, no disk I/O.
past_round_notes: Mean-reversion with inventory-aware quoting tends to win market-making products.
Pair trading works when two products have stable spreads in backtests but can collapse under volatility.
Orchids / conversion-heavy products punish naive traders who ignore storage/conversion costs.
prompt_addendum: Context: IMC Prosperity. The code must expose a `Trader` class with a `run(state)` method. Do NOT use Backtrader; use the Prosperity SDK types from `datamodel`. Do NOT print STRATENGINE_STATS — instead return (orders_by_product, conversions, trader_data).
